ci-bot: nightly-bench alert: p95 latency for small-batch (model-x, seq=512) jumped +28% vs baseline in preflight runs. failing test: runtime/small_batch_tail.py :alert:
Rita Chen: saw the notification, thanks. any obvious commit range?
Alex Kim: I pulled the latest artifacts, looks like the delta started after 9f3b2a4 (scheduler tweaks) — runs at ~02:10 UTC show the shift.
Sasha V: dashboard link: https://perf.redwood.internal/d/bench/small-batch?org=runtime — heatmap and traces attached. main diffs are syscall wait spikes and higher KV cache miss rate.
Rita Chen: ok can someone grab a flame/trace and a pprof after the failing run? need to confirm scheduler vs allocator.
Alex Kim: starting a repro locally now. quick command I used: ```bash
# run nightly locally with same seed
./tools/run_bench --suite small_batch --seed 42 --seq 512 --profile /tmp/prof
```
Alex Kim: first quick look: thread scheduler waits up around the same time as a memcopy in kernel. attaching short perf snippet: ```
# top hotspots
memcpy  36.1%
kv_cache_lookup 12.4%
scheduler_poll 9.8%
```
Matt O: I'm oncall in ~25m; if you want a hand with bisecting I can take over when I'm up. for immediate triage ping me @matt.o :bell: 
Rita Chen: Alex, can you try bisecting between baseline tag v2026-03-10 and HEAD? if it's noisy, we can narrow to the scheduler PRs.
Alex Kim: starting git bisect now; if anyone needs the session: I pushed a temporary branch `perf-bisect/3176` with the bisect script in tools/ci/bisect.sh.
June L: leaving a quick note: if this ends up being kv-cache churn, remember recent quantized-kv changes landed in PR #498. might be related to alignment changes.
Sasha V: adding synthetic repro runs to the dashboard (will take ~10m), also enabling verbose allocator logging for the next run.
Alex Kim: 1st bisect pass narrowed to commit range 9f3b2a4..c1e8f99, reproduces locally. profiling now for c1e8f99.
Rita Chen: great. can you post the bisect result and label as high-priority on the perf board? I'll create an issue (eng-runtime) with links and add oncall tag.
Alex Kim: done — bisect result: bad @ c1e8f99, good @ 9f3b2a4. creating a short writeup in the ticket, attaching perf dumps. :white_check_mark:
Matt O: thanks — I'll pick up follow-ups in 20m, will try an RSAN run across dedicated infra to confirm it's not local env funny.
June L: if it's the quantized-kv path, suggest adding a quick fallback to old alignment for canary to rollback easily.
Rita Chen: agreed. plan for now: Alex to add reproducer+minimal fix PR, Sasha to run infra-wide confirmation, Matt to validate on dedicated nodes and coordinate a canary rollback if needed. I'll own the ticket and update status. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: CI note: nightly runs will be paused for 30m to avoid noise while triage is in progress.
Sasha V: infra run finished — p95 still elevated on dedicated nodes, so this is real. sharing logs in the ticket.
Rita Chen: thanks. Alex—can you draft the PR with the mitigation and mark as WIP? we'll review async, and if green we can fast-follow.
Alex Kim: WIP PR up: https://git.redwood/infer/runtime/pulls/2743 — includes a toggle and a scoped revert for the allocator alignment. testing now.
Rita Chen: perfect. updating the perf issue and tagging eng-runtime, oncall. will reconvene in-thread if anything blocks.
Matt O: I'll post results from the dedicated run when I have them. good work everyone. :raised_hands:
